hero.title: Mia Task Capture
hero.subtitle: Paste a task. It’s in Mia.
hero.tagline: A Chrome MV3 extension that turns pasted or selected text into structured Mia tasks — category, priority, and due date — written to Firestore.
hero.impact: Classification mirrors the Flutter app: keyword rules plus optional Gemini Auto mode. Due defaults to tomorrow 11:59 PM; today/overdue saves as high priority. Sibling of Mia Calendar Capture.

problems.d: Task snippets live in email, docs, and tabs — retyping them into the app breaks flow.
Category, priority, and due logic must match Mia’s add-task / enrichment behavior.
Extension tasks must appear on the Mia list under the same guest uid.
Keyword fallbacks should work offline-ish; Gemini Auto when a key is configured.
